RE: Email addresses
Thursday, July 8, 2021 at 2:33:19 AM Eastern
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Greg Kehailia [opaque block] [contact omitted])
Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Gerardo Porta,[contact omitted] Clare Amador, [opaque block] [opaque block] [contact omitted] Kathryn Raymundo
[opaque block] [contact omitted]). [opaque block] [contact omitted] Gian Libot [opaque block] [contact omitted]),
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Leanne Lagman( [opaque block] [contact omitted]), [opaque block] [contact omitted] Jason Lambert
Many thanks for making the link on this, Gerry, most appreciated and very timely.
Clare: I hope you are well! Gerry told me about your conversation related to engagement of the advertising sector on
disinformation matters, and we would be very interested to hear more from you and your resource expert; and to tell you
more on our end about our plans under the about-to-be-launched "Ads for News" activity of the Initiative for Media
Freedom.
Shall we set a call sometime in the coming week(s) to discuss this?
We are in the process of finalizing the selection of the Philippine organization which will serve as implementing partner for
this activity, so for now it would be Internews personnel only on our side. The meeting would be attended by:
• [contact omitted] Kehailia [opaque block]
• [contact omitted] Raymundo [opaque block] ), Media Engagement Specialist
• [contact omitted] Libot ( [opaque block] , Senior Program Officer
• [contact omitted] Lagman, Research Project Officer
• If available, [contact omitted] Lambert, senior director for media business.
SinceJason is Denmark-based,it would be great if we could identify two or three dates when a meeting at 3pm or later
would be doable for the Facebook team.
Looking forward to discussing this!
Best,
Greg
Greg Kehailia | Country Director, Internews Philippines | Chief of Party, Initiative for Media Freedom || [opaque block] [contact omitted]
Mobile [opaque block]
[opaque block]
From: Gerardo Porta <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, July 8, 2021 1:56 PM
To: Clare Amador < [contact omitted]>

Cc: Greg Kehailia ( [opaque block] [contact omitted])< [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Email addresses
Hello Clare,
Thank you for the interesting conversation this morning. I am writing to reiterate our mutual interest in collaborating with
the advertising industry and our interest in having the meeting you suggested to explore possible areas of collaboration.
Greg Kehailia, the Chief of Party of the USAID-funded Initiative for Media Freedom project is copied here.
Cheers,
Gerry
On Thu, Jul 8,2021 at 11:03 AM Mercy Ria Orca <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Clare,
Thanks again for reaching out to exchange notes on the 2022 elections + collaboration
opportunities. Copied here colleagues who were in the meeting so we can be all connected via
email.
Democracy & Governance Team, Office of Economic Development and Governance,
USAID/Philippines:
• Ma. Teresa "Tet" Robielos - BARMM support project with The Asia Foundation
: Joey (Mendoza - Youta : demiacracy projet witr The Asia Fou ndition and elections
support project with the Ateneo School of Govt
• Ria - human rights social behavior change with The Asia Foundation
Looking forward to future collaboration meetings.
Best,
Ria
-
Gerardo A. Porta

Senior Democracy, Rights and Governance Specialist
Office of Economic Development and Governance
USAID/Philippines
